status: Transcribed by hand from the PDFs already in knowledge_base/documents (the RAG reference law). Verify article numbers before citing in the paper.
authority_note: These constraints come from statutes in the RAG corpus. A vacancy notice is a secondary source: where it differs, the engine flags a conflict instead of silently following the notice.

age.citation: Law 5/2009 (amends Law 8/2004), requirement (b): at least 17 and at most 55 years. Repo benchmark note DE04 cites it as Art. 14.

pass_mark.citation: Decree-Law 34/2008 Art. 35(1): 60 points or less in an eliminatory phase = disqualified

final_classification.method: simple or weighted arithmetic average of all selection methods

language.citation: Decree-Law 34/2008 Art. 23: fluency in at least one official language

appeal_working_days.citation: Decree-Law 34/2008 Art. 33(1): 5 working days to appeal an exclusion

medical_exam.citation: Decree-Law 34/2008 Art. 24: medical selection exam is eliminatory, public competitions only
